description: Source code for web clip tools in the Notesnook editor, including functions for settings, fullscreen, external opening, and source viewing of web clips.

methods.name: WebClipSettings
methods.description: Renders additional tools for web clip settings if active and positioned at bottom.

methods.name: WebClipFullScreen
methods.description: Enables fullscreen mode for the selected web clip iframe.

methods.name: WebClipOpenExternal
methods.description: Opens the iframe content in an external viewer or browser.

methods.name: WebClipOpenSource
methods.description: Opens the source URL of the selected web clip.
